pages.text: Autocrafting is one of Refined Storage's most powerful features, allowing you to automate the creation of items through your network. The system uses patterns to define crafting recipes and processing operations, then executes these tasks on demand. This guide will help you set up your first autocrafting system, from creating patterns to monitoring crafting operations.

Required Components:$(br)1. Pattern Grid - For creating patterns$(br)2. Patterns - To store crafting recipes$(br)3. Crafter - To execute crafting operations$(br)4. Crafting Monitor (optional) - To track crafting progress$(br)$(br)Begin by crafting a Pattern Grid and connecting it to your network. Then create Patterns for the items you want to autocraft. Place these patterns in a Crafter connected to your network. Finally, request items through any Grid interface to initiate crafting tasks.

When creating patterns, you have two options:$(br)$(br)1. Crafting Patterns - For standard crafting table recipes$(br)2. Processing Patterns - For machine operations like smelting$(br)$(br)Crafting patterns are created by arranging items in the Pattern Grid just as you would in a crafting table. Processing patterns allow you to specify inputs and expected outputs for external machines. The system is modular and expandable, allowing you to automate increasingly complex crafting operations as your network grows.
